note: Reference lesions for 'Verify against Lead-DBS': lesion masks and the Lead-DBS GSP1000v2 FullSet AvgR and T maps published in the van den Heuvel 2026 repository, at raw URLs pinned to one commit. Nothing here is bundled or downloaded automatically: the files are fetched only when the user starts a parity run after the GSP data use terms were shown. Each file's git blob id is pinned (verified after download); its sha256 is recorded in the cache manifest at the first download. The Lead-DBS maps are GSP-derived (terms GSP-DUT-2014).
